description.html: At 60x30x30 cm and 54 liters, this terrarium offers a clean glass space with decorative film on the outside. The film is functional: it stops animals from seeing their reflection and reduces stress, while helping the terrarium blend into your home.

With a floor area of 60x30 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
